title: Commercial Interior Design in Bratislava | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Design of offices, salons, shops and boutiques: project, 3D visualization and custom business furniture. Bratislava and Vienna, free consultation.

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) creates contemporary, functional, and bespoke interiors for commercial spaces. We design spaces that help express a brand’s character, create a comfortable environment for customers and employees, and make efficient use of every square meter.
We work with offices, stores, boutiques, beauty salons, dental clinics and medical offices, restaurants, cafés, hotels, showrooms, and other commercial properties.

Concept design We develop a bespoke commercial interior concept that takes into account the nature of the business, the corporate identity, the target audience, functional requirements, and the specific features of the space.
The interior becomes part of the company’s visual identity and helps create a recognizable brand atmosphere.
Layout and functional zoning Smart space planning is especially important for commercial premises.
We develop layout solutions based on operational workflows, visitor and staff circulation, and the placement of furniture, equipment, lighting, and the necessary work areas.
For offices, we design reception areas, meeting rooms, executive offices, workspaces, lounge areas, office kitchens, cafeterias, and common areas.
For stores and boutiques, we plan sales areas, display windows, fitting rooms, checkout areas, storage systems, and customer flow.
3D visualization of commercial interiors We create photorealistic 3D visualizations that let you see the future interior before the project is implemented.
3D visualization shows the layout, furniture, materials, color schemes, lighting, and decorative elements, and helps finalize key decisions in advance.
Materials and finishes We select finishing materials based on the design, the purpose of the space, the intensity of use, practicality requirements, and the project budget.
For commercial interiors, durability, ease of maintenance, and materials that keep their original appearance under heavy use are especially important.
Commercial lighting Lighting is an essential part of a commercial interior’s architecture.
Depending on the purpose of the space, we develop different scenarios of general, task, accent, and decorative lighting.
Well-planned lighting helps create the right atmosphere, highlight products or individual interior features, and provide comfortable conditions for visitors and staff.

Custom furniture. DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs custom furniture for commercial spaces: reception desks, retail fixtures, display cases, shelving units, cabinets, storage systems, desks, conference tables, office kitchens, decorative panels, and other elements.
Detailed furniture drawings and technical specifications are prepared for production.
Furniture manufacturing, delivery, and installation based on the completed design are also available.
Branding in the interior A commercial interior can become an extension of a company’s corporate identity.
Logos, signage, brand colors, wayfinding, and graphic and decorative elements can be integrated into the design concept to create a recognizable image of the space.
Technical documentation Depending on the project scope, we prepare the technical documentation and working drawings needed to implement the approved concept.
The documentation helps coordinate the work of contractors, furniture manufacturers, and other specialists involved in implementing the project.
Project support Depending on the project, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can oversee the implementation of the developed concept and liaise with contractors, suppliers, and furniture manufacturers.
This helps preserve the integrity of the original design at the various stages of bringing the commercial interior to life.
Modern and practical solutions In our designs, we take into account the safety, accessibility, functional, and operational requirements of each specific commercial space.
At the client’s request, natural materials, energy-efficient lighting, and other resource-efficient solutions can be used.
Design for a wide range of commercial spaces We develop bespoke interior solutions for various types of business:
— offices and business spaces;
— stores and boutiques;
— beauty salons;
— barbershops;
— showrooms;
— dental clinics and medical offices;
— restaurants and cafés;
— hotels and apartments;
— studios and service spaces;
— other commercial premises.
Every project is created individually, taking into account the nature of the business, the specifics of the property, and the client’s goals.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — commercial interior design, 3D visualization, technical documentation, custom furniture, and full project implementation.
We create commercial spaces that work for your business.
